title: Chamak Pehle, Dhamaka Baad Mein… Kyun? ⚡ #shorts
title_en: Why Lightning Comes Before Thunder? Count to 3 ⚡ #shorts
description:
Bijli chamki… aur awaaz 3 second baad aayi? Is Short mein raaz: roshni aur awaaz ki race, aur garaj asal mein hai kya.
Agli baar baarish mein ginti karein — har 3 second = 1 kilometer!

Lightning and thunder happen at the same moment — light reaches you instantly, sound walks at about 343 m/s (≈3 seconds per km).
Thunder itself is air heated to ~30,000°C (5x hotter than the Sun's surface) bursting outward.

بجلی پہلے چمکتی ہے، گرج بعد میں کیوں آتی ہے؟ تین تک گنیں… اور فاصلہ جانیں!

description_en:
Why do you see lightning before you hear thunder? Both happen at the same moment — but light reaches you instantly while sound walks at about 343 m/s.
Count the seconds: every 3 seconds = 1 km. And the boom? Air heated to ~30,000°C (5x the Sun's surface) bursting outward.
